title: Tiers of Emergency Response Management
cross_references: State Emergency Relief and Recovery Plan

nodes.text: Operate at three tiers: incident, region, and state

evidence.source_text: Victorian emergency response management operates at three tiers; incident, region and state.

nodes.text: Is there a forecast of extreme weather or intelligence of a large scale emergency?

evidence.source_text: such as where there is: a forecast of extreme weather; or intelligence or information of any anticipated large scale emergency affecting life or property.

nodes.text: Activate regional and state tier arrangements for major emergencies

evidence.source_text: Regional and state tier arrangements are activated where a major emergency has occurred or is anticipated to occur.

nodes.text: Activate regional and state tier arrangements on a continuing basis

evidence.source_text: Where emergencies can be reasonably expected over a period of time, the regional and state tier arrangements may be activated on a continuing basis.
